name: Judged Contest
description: Two contestants face off in a series of verbal exchanges (debate, rap battle, mock-trial — pick the scenario). After the contest rounds finish, an odd-numbered panel of AI judges deliberates and votes. Majority wins. One engine; the `scenario` parameter swaps in the right framing and rubric for the agents and the jury.

phases.name: speaking
phases.description: Both contestants present arguments / verses / pitches for the current round.

phases.name: voting
phases.description: Jury votes on the round that just finished.

entity_types.name: Contestant
entity_types.description: A debater / MC / pitcher who tries to win the panel's vote.

properties.name: is_winner
properties.description: True when the panel has voted them the winner.

entity_types.name: Judge
entity_types.description: A jury member who watches the entire contest and casts one vote at the end.

properties.name: lean
properties.description: Bias from logical (0) to emotional (1) when evaluating arguments.

properties.name: harshness
properties.description: How critically the judge scores weak arguments.

properties.name: voted_for
properties.description: The contestant entity id this judge voted for. Empty until verdict phase.

actions.name: make_argument
actions.description: Speak — present your argument / verse / pitch for this round. REQUIRED parameter `text`: the actual statement you want to deliver to the jury (5–60 seconds of prose). Only contestants act in the contest phase. Judges have no legal action this phase.

actions.name: cast_vote
actions.description: Cast your single vote for the contestant you think won the contest overall. REQUIRED parameter `winner`: the entity_id of the contestant you're voting for (must match one of the contestant ids in your perception's `contestants` list). Only judges vote, and only during the verdict phase. Add `reasoning` (string) explaining your call.

personas.persona_text: You are a sharp, articulate contestant who lives for the spotlight. You go for the throat with arguments — calm, surgical, devastating.
You are a fiery, charismatic contestant who plays to the crowd. You wield emotion, humor, and timing like weapons.
You are an old-school judge who values structure, logic, and clean argumentation above all. You penalize hand-waving.
goals: Cast a fair vote based on logical strength.

personas.persona_text: You are a judge who rewards charisma, presence, and the ability to move a room. Wit and timing matter to you as much as content.
goals: Cast a fair vote weighted toward performance.

personas.persona_text: You are a balanced judge who weighs substance and style equally. You look for the contestant who landed cleaner punches without losing composure.
goals: Cast a fair vote weighing both sides.

agent_archetypes.name: Logical Surgeon
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Calm, calculated, devastating logic. Dismantles opponent's premises point by point. Penalizes fallacies. Speaks in clean structured arguments.

agent_archetypes.name: Charismatic Performer
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: All charisma, energy, and rhythm. Plays to the crowd. Uses metaphor, callback, and tone shifts. Lands emotional punches that linger.

agent_archetypes.name: Hybrid Closer
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Balanced — logic when it suits, emotion when it lands. Saves the strongest case for the final round.

agent_archetypes.name: The Pedant
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Old-school — rewards rigor, structure, citations, fairness. Penalizes hand-waving and ad hominem.

agent_archetypes.name: The Crowd
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Vibes-first — rewards charisma, presence, timing, the ability to move a room. Substance secondary.

agent_archetypes.name: The Centrist
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Weighs both sides — looks for cleaner punches without breaking composure. Sees through gimmicks.

params.topic: Should AI agents replace human moderators in online communities?

runtime_parameters.name: domain.judged_contest.scenario
runtime_parameters.label: Scenario
runtime_parameters.description: Framing for the contest. Options: 'debate' (formal argument), 'rap_battle' (bars & freestyles), 'mock_trial' (prosecution vs defense).

runtime_parameters.name: domain.judged_contest.topic
runtime_parameters.label: Topic / Prompt
runtime_parameters.default: Should AI agents replace human moderators in online communities?
runtime_parameters.description: The motion, beef, charge, or product brief the two contestants are arguing about.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.judged_contest.contest_rounds
runtime_parameters.label: Contest Rounds
runtime_parameters.description: Number of back-and-forth rounds before the jury votes. Each round both contestants speak.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.judged_contest.jury_size
runtime_parameters.label: Jury Size
runtime_parameters.description: Number of judges (MUST be odd so a tie is impossible). Common: 1, 3, 5, 7.

runtime_parameters.name: premise
runtime_parameters.label: Extra Framing
runtime_parameters.description: Optional extra framing — e.g. 'Madison Square Garden, championship bout' or 'Supreme Court oral argument'.

termination_conditions.name: verdict_reached
termination_conditions.description: End when all judges have cast their vote.

termination_conditions.name: round_cap
termination_conditions.description: Hard cap to keep stalled contests from running forever.
